---
title: "07 · Feedback, verification, and repair"
---

What evidence warrants another attempt?

## Concepts

Compare deterministic verifiers and judgment-based graders. Specify the repair budget and track whether improvements in the verifier score transfer to the intended outcome [@shinn2023reflexion].

## Study task

Inject a clearly documented disagreement between validation and holdout rankings. Design a decision rule that can detect when to stop spending trials without consulting the holdout during search.

## Deliverable

Submit an error taxonomy, a stopping rule, and two traces that distinguish a candidate failure from an evaluator failure.
